title: Root disk full from unrotated debug logs
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the web/API component, the disk‑full problem, and the new collect-debug-logs cron job as the cause.
root_cause: The collect-debug-logs cron job writes API debug dumps to /var/log/shop/debug.log, which has grown to 17.5 GB and filled the root filesystem, causing the API container to fail when trying to write logs and return 500 errors.
truth: A new cron job 'collect-debug-logs' was added two days ago. It writes verbose debug output to /var/log/shop/debug.log but the logrotate config was not updated for this file, so the log grows unbounded. The root disk (/) reached 97% used, leaving no space for nginx to write its access log or for the api container to write its log, causing 500 errors on all dynamic requests.
check_first: api container logs or health status
